hints.purpose: UNLIKELY hints only; no code-generation improvement; built but not measured

cold.purpose: Cold geometry diagnostic plus combined check; exploratory build, not measured separately

outlined.purpose: Combined geometry check and noinline allocator wrapper
outlined.decision: Rejected: exploratory v1 blocking-hit regression of about 15-20%; raw screen limitations retained

sequential.purpose: Cold diagnostic helper, original geometry-check order, noinline allocator validation wrapper
sequential.decision: Resident hit screen promising; formatted into candidate

mask-original.purpose: Use alignment mask and assert power-of-two page size at config init
mask-original.decision: Diagnostic control only. The original 48 MiB probe was inconclusive; the 32-page hot-set control supported combining the alignment mask with async-load.

mask-main.purpose: Same alignment-mask change to main as an experimental control

isolated-miss.purpose: Outline complete sync miss handling; move async validation into disk child
isolated-miss.decision: Not selected: handle escape in sync path and no clear advantage over sequential

candidate.purpose: Formatted sequential with clarified diagnostic-helper comment
candidate.decision: 118 unit executions plus admission passed; resident results promising, but a nonblocking-miss wrapper added 21 instructions/op and about 0.6 ns; superseded

async-load.purpose: Cold diagnostic helper; move async validation into existing disk child; retain inline sync validation
async-load.decision: Historical intermediate, superseded by async-mask. Its 118 checks and all cache/database/miss evidence are retained. An earlier no-WAL wall-time loss failed to repeat in later fixed/shared cohorts; the cause remains unresolved.

async-mask.purpose: async-load plus bit-mask hot alignment validation and power-of-two configuration assertion
async-mask.decision: Selected and applied to target. 124 unit executions, formatting, admission and bounded I/O churn passed. Final resident read/hit, hot-set read, valid-miss, resident-write and database confirmations are complete and audited. Read/hit means versus main range from -1.08% to +1.67%; writes from -0.16% to +0.40%. Valid nonblocking misses improve 17.84% versus original but retain 3.47 additional CPU ns/op versus main. No-WAL database insertion wall time remains indeterminate; no universal 3% equivalence claim.
